steps.title: Opening GitHub issues page for browser-use/browser-use
Clicking "Filter by labels" to add enhancement label filter
steps.code:
await page.click({ ref: "e276" })
await wait({ waitTime: 2 })
var snap = await page.snapshot()
console.log(snap.snapshot.outline())
steps.rationale: I can see the issues page loaded with 181 open issues. Now I need to filter by the "enhancement" label and sort by most recently updated. Let me start by clicking the "Filter by labels" button.

steps.title: Clicking enhancement label and setting sort order
steps.rationale: Good, I can see the labels dialog opened. Now I need to click "enhancement" to add it as a filter. Let me also check the sort option.

steps.title: Selecting enhancement label from the dialog
steps.rationale: I see the labels dialog is still open. Let me select the enhancement label and apply it.

steps.title: Looking at the labels dialog for apply/close buttons
steps.rationale: I see the labels dialog is still open - clicking the option didn't close it. Let me look at what buttons are available to apply the filter and close the dialog.

steps.title: Finding the apply button and sort dropdown
Finding enhancement option and label buttons
steps.rationale: Let me look at the labels dialog more carefully and see how to select the enhancement label.

steps.title: Closing the dialog and finding the labels filter bar
Typing label:enhancement filter in search box
steps.rationale: I can see the page structure. Let me add the label filter and sort directly by typing into the search bar.

steps.title: Getting detailed issue list with URLs and dates
steps.rationale: The filter is working — 25 open enhancement issues sorted by most recently updated. Now I need to extract the issue details and hover over the relative dates to get exact timestamps. Let me read the data carefully.

steps.title: Hovering on first issue's Updated date for tooltip
steps.code:
// Hover on the "Updated on" text for each issue to see if tooltip appears
await page.hover({ ref: "e1308" })
await wait({ waitTime: 2 })
var afterHover = await page.snapshot()
console.log(afterHover.snapshot.grep("Updated", { context: 3 }))
console.log("===")
console.log(afterHover.snapshot.grep("tooltip", { context: 5 }))
steps.rationale: Let me hover on the date elements to check for tooltip timestamps.
